title: 第七章 吞金纳铁第八章 凌晨四点的赭石谷
lines: 西隆回到巢穴，把矿石放在地上。
尽管分给莫奇一部分，剩下的却也仍然不少，大大小小堆在一起，表面裂出暗红色的纹路，像是一堆安静燃烧的炭。
他期待使用自己的能力，已经等了好几天，这时却没立刻把矿石往嘴里塞，而是先动起爪子，把每一块矿石都用力掰开，碎成方便吞咽的小块。
虽然龙类不会像巨蜥那样把自己噎死，但若落到那个场面，也会非常难堪狼狈。
在这种时候，西隆不想横生枝节。
直到所有准备工作完成，铬龙才在巢穴里正襟危坐，把碎矿小口小口吞下去。
哪怕巨龙号称可以吞噬万物，但真要它们去吃石头，个个都会觉得很不好受。
碎矿粗粝锋利，勉强吞进咽峡、刮过喉壁，全是火辣辣的痛感。
好在西隆可以发动能力。
【吞金纳铁】
胃里先是一暖，仿佛饮下一口滚烫的热汤，接着整个胸腔都暖和起来。
不同于吞食血肉所产生的饱腹感，矿石进到胃里，却像是将要渴死的人，忽然等到了久违的水分，顷刻间舒畅非常。
那些养分不急不迫，缓慢的渗进四肢，滋养肌肉骨骼，流向每一个神经末梢，让所有细胞全都发出振奋的欢呼。
西隆悠长的呼吸，把秋日的清爽空气尽数吸入肺里，再一点点吐出。
吞金纳铁并不是什么罕见的能力，历史上许多巨龙曾有过类似的天赋，譬如在西隆传承里留下名字的，“金星铸者”诺恩隆顿——
一条曾在浩劫之战中大放异彩的半神铁龙。
传说诺恩隆顿很早便觉醒了吸收金属的天赋，后来更是吞噬了一整个脉金星球，才铸成那具连神灵也为之侧目的穹隆巨躯。
可它终究还是死了，被三尾龙后的女儿泽拉妮娅所杀，无法抵抗初代种的血谕威能。
和那些赫赫有名的强大存在相比，西隆的成长之路才刚刚开始。
另一方面，【吞金纳铁】并非只指黄金和铁，也包括其他金属。
但它每次所能消化的金属是有限度的，会根据所吞食的金属品级，缓慢激活龙类潜能，小幅提升使用者的体魄，能力生效期间，无法被再次使用。
西隆知道自己所吞食的，只是最低级的铁矿石，甚至不是粗铁，金属含量很低。
但眼下他也只是雏龙，一条刚刚破壳不久的幼崽，只想以最简单的方式尽快体验能力，并不好高骛远，能吃上这样一口，已经心满意足。
一股困意涌了上来，懒洋洋的，不像睡前的疲倦，而是身体正在给他提醒，告诉西隆悄无声息的变化正在发生。
小铬龙没有抗拒，随意放松四肢，蜷身匍匐在砂石上，面颊压住麦秆，很快进入睡梦之中。
醒来已是第二天。
清晨，赭石谷的天还没亮透，薄薄的晨雾笼在山坳里，小铬龙站起来，抖落鳞片上的砂砾，缓缓的磨吮牙齿。
前几日啃咬矿石留下的裂痕和缺口，如今消失的无影无踪。
裂痕被修复、缺口被补齐，西隆抬起爪趾，对着獠牙叩了叩，听到一声清脆的鸣响，再无任何痛感。
喂哺者果然所言非虚。
经过矿石研磨的牙齿，明显出现了些许强化，比以前更加粗壮锋利，森森然排列在口腔里，迎着晨曦映出光芒，好似钢锻。
除此之外，西隆还察觉到另一种变化。
说不上具体哪里不同，只是活动四肢的时候，好像卸去了某种负担，有种极其轻快顺畅的感觉。
content_en:
Shillong returned to the lair and placed the ore on the ground.
Even though some were given to Mo Qi, there was still a lot left over, piled together in large and small sizes, with dark red lines cracking on the surface, like a pile of quietly burning coals.
He was looking forward to using his ability and had been waiting for several days. However, he did not immediately stuff the ore into his mouth. Instead, he used his claws to break each piece of ore apart and break it into small pieces that were easy to swallow.
Although dragons will not choke themselves to death like monitor lizards, they will still be very embarrassed if they fall into that situation.
At this time, Shillong doesn't want to create complications.
It wasn't until all the preparations were completed that the Chrome Dragon sat upright in its lair and swallowed the broken ore in small mouthfuls.
Even though giant dragons claim to be able to devour all things, everyone would feel very uncomfortable if they really had to eat stones.
The crushed ore was rough and sharp, and it was barely swallowed into the pharynx and scraped across the throat wall, causing a burning pain.
Fortunately, Shillong can activate the ability.
[Tomb gold and iron]
My stomach felt warm at first, as if I drank a mouthful of scalding hot soup, and then my entire chest warmed up.
Different from the feeling of fullness caused by swallowing flesh and blood, when the ore enters the stomach, it is like a person who is about to die of thirst, suddenly waiting for long-lost water, and feels very comfortable in an instant.
Those nutrients are unhurried, slowly seeping into the limbs, nourishing the muscles and bones, flowing to every nerve ending, making all cells cheer in excitement.
Shillong took a long breath, sucking all the fresh autumn air into his lungs, and then spit it out little by little.
Swallowing gold and iron is not a rare ability. Many dragons in history have had similar talents, such as Norn Longton, the "Former of Venus" who left his name in Shillong's inheritance——
A demigod iron dragon that once showed great glory in the catastrophic battle.
Legend has it that Norn Longton awakened the talent of absorbing metal very early, and later devoured an entire planet of gold before he built that giant dome body that even the gods looked at.
But it died after all, being killed by Zerania, the daughter of the three-tailed dragon queen, unable to resist the power of the blood oracle of the first generation species.
Compared with those famous and powerful beings, Shillong's growth has just begun.
On the other hand, "Tun Jin Na Iron" does not only refer to gold and iron, but also includes other metals.
However, there is a limit to the amount of metal it can digest each time. It will slowly activate the dragon's potential based on the grade of the metal it swallows, slightly improving the user's physique. While the ability is in effect, it cannot be used again.
Shillong knew that what he had swallowed was only the lowest grade of iron ore, not even crude iron, with very low metal content.
But right now, he is just a young dragon, a cub that has just emerged from its shell. He just wants to experience his abilities in the simplest way as soon as possible. He is not ambitious. He is satisfied with just one bite like this.
A wave of sleepiness came over him, lazily, not like the tiredness before going to bed, but his body was reminding him that silent changes were taking place in Shillong.
The little chromium dragon did not resist, relaxed its limbs at will, curled up and crawled on the gravel, pressed its cheek against the wheat straw, and quickly fell asleep.
…
It's the next day when I wake up.
In the early morning, the sky was not yet bright in the Ocher Valley, and a thin morning mist enveloped the mountain col. The little Chrome Dragon stood up, shook off the gravel on its scales, and slowly grinded its teeth.
The cracks and gaps left by chewing on the ore a few days ago have now disappeared without a trace.
The cracks were repaired and the gaps were filled. Shillong raised his claws and tapped his fangs. He heard a crisp sound and no longer felt any pain.
What the feeder said was indeed true.
The teeth that have been ground by ore have obviously been strengthened a little, and are thicker and sharper than before. They are arranged densely in the mouth, reflecting the light in the morning sun, like steel forging.
Besides this, Shillong also noticed another change.
I can't say what's the specific difference, but when I move my limbs, I feel like I've been relieved of some kind of burden, and I feel extremely light and smooth.
title_en: Chapter 7 Tunjin Natie Chapter 8 Ocher Valley at four o'clock in the morning
